kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَذَفَ • (ḥaḏafa) I (non-past يَحْذِفُ (yaḥḏifu), verbal noun حَذْف (ḥaḏf))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Verb form I from the root ح ذ ف (ḥ ḏ f).
g: to shorten, to clip, to curtail
to cut off, to clip off
to strike out, to cross out
to elide, to apocopate, to drop by apheresis

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَذَّفَ • (ḥaḏḏafa) II (non-past يُحَذِّفُ (yuḥaḏḏifu), verbal noun تَحْذِيف (taḥḏīf))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Verb form II from the root ح ذ ف (ḥ ḏ f).
g: to give shape, to cut, clip, or trim into proper shape

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَذْف • (ḥaḏf) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Verbal noun from حَذَفَ (ḥaḏafa).
g: cancellation, crossing out, deletion, omission, dropping, suppression

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَذَف • (ḥaḏaf) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ح ذ ف (ḥ ḏ f) in the sense of "trimming (especially laterally)", from the تَحْذِيفُ الشَّعَر (taḥḏīfu š-šaʕar, “undercut hairstyle”); so called for the distinctive teal-colored side patches on the bird's head.
g: teal (some birds in the genus Anas)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَذَفِيّ • (ḥaḏafiyy) (feminine حَذَفِيَّة (ḥaḏafiyya), masculine plural حَذَفِيُّون (ḥaḏafiyyūn), feminine plural حَذَفِيَّات (ḥaḏafiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: حَذَف (ḥaḏaf, “teal”) + ـِيّ (-iyy). And probably semantic loan from English teal.
